task:
Open the file /home/user/Documents/students.xlsx in LibreOffice Calc. It contains two sheets:
- 'Roster' with columns: Student ID (A), Name (B), Major (C). Row 1 has headers, rows 2-13 have 12 students with IDs 1001-1012.
- 'Scores' with columns: Student ID (A), Test 1 (B), Test 2 (C), Test 3 (D). Row 1 has headers, rows 2-13 have the same 12 students' test scores.

1. Go to the 'Scores' sheet.
2. In cell E1, enter 'Student Name' and make it bold.
3. In cell E2, enter the formula =VLOOKUP(A2,Roster.$A$1:$B$13,2,0) to look up the student's name from the Roster sheet based on the Student ID in column A. Copy this formula down through E3:E13 for all students.
4. In cell F1, enter 'Average' and make it bold.
5. In cell F2, enter the formula =AVERAGE(B2:D2) to compute the average of the three test scores. Copy this formula down through F3:F13.
6. Sort the entire data range A1:F13 by column F (Average) in descending order, so the highest-scoring student appears at the top. Make sure headers stay in row 1.
7. Save the file .
